Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

We value the contributions you make to our team and want to ensure that our workplace remains a positive and professional environment for everyone. Recently, we have received some feedback regarding specific interactions that do not align with our company’s core values of respect and collaboration.

We believe in open communication and are committed to supporting your professional growth. We would like to discuss this matter with you to understand the context and work together on a path forward that ensures everyone feels respected and supported.

Please let us know when you are available for a brief meeting this week to discuss this further.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]

***

The animal known for its long neck is the giraffe.
